hero.sub: Eyegis was created for a generation that spends more time looking at screens than ever before. Our mission is to make digital life more comfortable — without sacrificing timeless design.
hero.alt: Eyegis campaign — couple wearing Men's Collection and Women's Collection frames

belief.p1: Modern life has changed. We work, study, create, communicate and play — almost entirely through digital devices. Yet the objects designed to protect our eyes still feel like an afterthought.
belief.p2: Eyegis believes visual comfort should be part of everyday life — not a medical accessory, not a gimmick. Simply a beautifully engineered object you'd want to wear anyway.

why.h1: Digital lifestyles have changed. Eyewear hasn't.
why.p1: We spend eight to twelve hours a day in front of screens — phones, laptops, monitors, tablets, consoles. And still, most blue-light eyewear feels stuck in another decade.
why.p2: Most blue-light glasses either look overly technical — or make exaggerated promises they can't measure. Eyegis was created to bridge that gap: honest optical engineering, expressed through timeless design.

items.title: Honest Science™
items.body: We publish what our lenses do — and what they don't. No inflated claims, no theatrical numbers. Only measurable optical performance.

items.title: Timeless Design
items.sub: Created to be worn every day.
items.body: Silhouettes designed to outlast trends. Proportions studied for a decade of wear, not a season of hype.

items.title: Engineered Comfort
items.body: Ultralight TR90 frames, titanium hinges, hypoallergenic pads. When comfort is right, the frame simply fades away.

values.h2: Four principles that guide every decision.

items.d: Independent lab data, published openly. If we can't measure it, we don't claim it.
Materials chosen for longevity — TR90, β-titanium, CR-39 optical resin, real hinge screws.
Every frame is inspected by hand. Every lens is tested against ISO optical standards.
We design for real faces, real screens and real hours — not for a studio render.

global.h2: Built for the global digital generation.
global.p: International mindset. Timeless products. Premium quality — worn from Tokyo to São Paulo, from Paris to Los Angeles.

promise.quote: "Every pair of Eyegis glasses is designed with one simple purpose — help you enjoy your digital life more comfortably, while looking your best."

belief.p1: La vie moderne a changé. Nous travaillons, étudions, créons, communiquons et jouons — presque entièrement via des appareils numériques. Pourtant, les objets censés protéger nos yeux ressemblent encore à un détail secondaire.
belief.p2: Eyegis pense que le confort visuel doit faire partie de la vie quotidienne — pas un accessoire médical, pas un gadget. Simplement un objet magnifiquement conçu, que l'on a envie de porter.

why.alt1: Les écrans entourent la vie moderne
why.h1: Les vies numériques ont changé. Pas les lunettes.
why.p1: Nous passons huit à douze heures par jour devant des écrans — téléphones, ordinateurs, moniteurs, tablettes, consoles. Et pourtant, la plupart des lunettes anti-lumière bleue semblent figées dans une autre décennie.
why.p2: La plupart des lunettes anti-lumière bleue paraissent trop techniques — ou multiplient les promesses invérifiables. Eyegis a été créée pour combler ce fossé : une ingénierie optique honnête, portée par un design intemporel.

items.title: Honest Science™
items.body: Nous publions ce que font nos verres — et ce qu'ils ne font pas. Aucune promesse gonflée, aucun chiffre théâtral. Seulement des performances optiques mesurables.

items.title: Design intemporel
items.sub: Conçu pour être porté chaque jour.
items.body: Des silhouettes pensées pour survivre aux tendances. Des proportions étudiées pour une décennie d'usage, pas une saison de hype.

items.title: Confort d'ingénierie

values.h2: Quatre principes qui guident chaque décision.
